verdict.rationale: Office Click-to-Run's Integrator.exe (SYSTEM, legitimate path) spawned schtasks.exe to delete the Microsoft\Office\OfficeBackgroundTaskHandlerLogon task, which is routine Office install/update behavior. The 0x1fffff process access events come from the parent and csrss.exe during process creation, so they are expected and not injection.
